params.name: originChain
params.description: The source chain from which the cross-chain swap will originate. Can be specified as chain ID or name. See [here](https://0x-docs.gitbook.io/0x-cross-chain-api-beta/developer-resources/supported-chains-and-providers) for the list of supported chains

params.name: destinationChain
params.description: The destination chain where tokens will be received after the cross-chain swap. Can be specified as chain ID or name. See [here](https://0x-docs.gitbook.io/0x-cross-chain-api-beta/developer-resources/supported-chains-and-providers) for the list of supported chains

params.name: sellToken
params.description: The contract address of the token to sell on the origin chain. Format varies by chain type (EVM address for EVM/HyperCore chains, token mint address for Solana, base58check address for Tron)

params.name: buyToken
params.description: The contract address of the token to buy on the destination chain. Format varies by chain type (EVM address for EVM/HyperCore chains, token mint address for Solana, base58check address for Tron)

params.name: sellAmount
params.description: The amount of `sellToken` (in `sellToken`'s base units) to sell on the origin chain

params.name: originAddress
params.description: The wallet address on the origin chain that holds the sellToken balance and will initiate the cross-chain transaction

params.name: destinationAddress
params.description: The wallet address on the destination chain that will receive the buyToken. If not specified, defaults to originAddress on the destination chain

params.name: gasPayer
params.description: The Solana address that will pay for transaction fees when the origin chain is Solana. Only applicable for Solana origin chains

params.name: slippageBps
params.description: The maximum acceptable slippage for each swap or bridge step of the cross-chain swap in basis points (100 = 1%)

params.name: excludedBridges
params.description: Comma-separated list of bridge providers to exclude from routing

params.name: includedBridges
params.description: Comma-separated list of bridge providers to include in routing. Mutually exclusive with excludedBridges

params.name: excludedSwapSources
params.description: Comma-separated list of DEX sources to exclude from routing on both chains

params.name: feeBps
params.description: The trading fee amounts in basis points to charge on the origin chain (supports single or comma-separated values). Must be used together with feeRecipient. When multiple values are provided, must match the length of feeRecipient. Note: integrator fee collection is not yet supported for Tron-originated routes.

params.name: feeRecipient
params.description: The wallet addresses to receive trading fees on the origin chain (supports single or comma-separated values). Must be used together with feeBps. When multiple values are provided, must match the length of feeBps. Note: integrator fee collection is not yet supported for Tron-originated routes.

params.name: feeToken
params.description: The token addresses for fee collection on the origin chain (supports single or comma-separated values). Must be the same as sellToken. When multiple values are provided, must match the length of feeBps. If omitted, defaults to sellToken. Note: integrator fee collection is not yet supported for Tron-originated routes.

params.name: sortQuotesBy
params.description: How to sort the returned quotes - either by speed (fastest execution time) or price (best exchange rate)

params.name: maxNumQuotes
params.description: The maximum number of cross-chain quotes to return, between 1 and 10. Each quote represents a different combination of bridges and DEXs

items.docs: Get the quotes for a cross chain swap

params.name: originChain
params.description: The origin chain where the cross-chain transaction was initiated

params.name: originTxHash
params.description: The transaction hash on the origin chain to track. Format varies by chain type (32-byte hex for EVM/HyperCore, base58 signature for Solana, 64-char hex for Tron)

params.name: quoteId
params.description: The quote ID associated with the cross-chain transaction

params.description: The wallet address of the user to get transaction history for. Accepts EVM (0x...), Solana, and Tron addresses

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of transactions to return
